body.x: Crowdworks(CEO Min-woo Park) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

Crowdworks is an AI & Human Resources Platform that builds artificial intelligence data based on crowdsourcing. The company representative explained that since its establishment in 2017, it has achieved 1,000% growth, and is continuing to expand the number of crowdsourcing workers to the largest scale in Korea. It has been conducting data collaboration with more than 430 AI leading companies, and has been recognized overseas as it has been listed as a sample vendor in the 2022 Gartner Hype Cycle Report “Data Labeling and Processing Division” for the first time in Korea this year.
At this CES Crowdworks aims to introduce their new product ‘Workstage’ to improve the brand, and to export the ‘Workstage’ solution.

Around 80% of the data produced today is unstructured data that is difficult for artificial intelligence models to learn directly, so it is necessary to preprocess the data to make it suitable for machine learning for the purpose of artificial intelligence development. As Crowdworks’ artificial intelligence learning data preprocessing platform, ‘Workstage’ contributes to securing and improving customer’s AI performance by easily gathering and processing AI learning data necessary for the customer’s AI model development.

The platform provides almost all functions for collecting and processing voice, image, video, and text data in template form, making it easy to set up data projects. It has the largest number of domestic crowd workers (400,000) and has built more than 1 million data points, and is characterized by its enhanced management functions for exceptional situations based on the vast amount of behavioral data accumulated (worker/reviewer allocation, real-time monitoring, worker/reviewer performance management, machine learning-based smart labeling).

In particular, Workstage is optimized for customers who do not want to release data externally, handle sensitive data due to personal information regulations and security issues, or want to directly control and manage data. It can be provided in SaaS or On-Premise formats according to the security requirements of the customer.

A Crowdworks representative stated, "The data produced on our platform is supplied to companies that develop artificial intelligence technologies or services such as voice recognition, image recognition and vision, AI interpretation and translation, medical AI, and autonomous driving. Currently, Crowdworks provides services in all stages from defining artificial intelligence data requirements to building them through derivative products such as end-to-end data processing services including data requirement definition and consulting based on the Workstage platform, and crowdworker matching services."

Additionally, Crowdworks stated that it plans to expand its foremarket through the provision of artificial intelligence data consulting services, and its aftermarket through model development services and model performance verification services.

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
